name: The Symphony of Frozen Soundwaves
description: A glacial valley where sound has crystallized into towering geometric formations, each representing a different note frozen mid-air, glowing with aurora colors when touched by wind.
prompt: A vast glacial valley where sound waves have physically crystallized into towering translucent geometric sculptures -- spiraling helices, angular fractals, and sweeping ribbons of ice -- each formation glowing with embedded aurora borealis colors (emerald, violet, rose). Wind passes through them creating actual harmonic resonance visible as shimmering light particles. Massive ice crystals shaped like frozen musical notation float weightlessly. Northern lights dance overhead, their curtains matching the crystal formations below. Hyper-detailed, 8K, volumetric lighting, subsurface scattering in ice, magical realism, wide panoramic perspective.
caption: What if you could see music frozen in time? ❄️🎵 This valley captures every note ever sung here as living crystal. Touch a formation and hear its song release into the wind. What melody would you leave behind?
